speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
title: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan spoke about “The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants”.

quotes.text: So, you might assume that I was raised in a family that belonged to The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. But I was not. My family were members of a different church that also believes in the Book of Mormon and the prophetic mission of Joseph Smith. I am deeply grateful for that heritage, a heritage that began with my third-great-grandparents Francis and Mary Ann Case, who were baptized by Oliver Cowdery in 1831 and helped establish Nauvoo and build the house of the Lord.
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: They did not travel west with the Saints; nevertheless, I was raised with a knowledge and testimony of the Prophet Joseph Smith. My mother actually gave me my middle name, Joseph, after the Prophet of the Restoration. And she gave me much more than that. She taught me about the restored gospel and the Book of Mormon.
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: But more than any words that I heard or did not hear, I knew the Book of Mormon was important to my mother. And I knew she knew it was true. Even as a single mother, she made the extraordinary effort to read the Book of Mormon to me every day until it was finished. As she did, she was fulfilling the admonition of the Lord, who said, “Remember the new covenant, even the Book of Mormon.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Because of my mother’s extraordinary efforts, I knew the Book of Mormon was true and that Joseph Smith was a prophet of God. Even so, I was confused and uncertain as to where the true Church of Jesus Christ was. When I was 14, I began to question the church of my childhood. I knew members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints; they were my friends.
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: It would be some time before I could join the Church, and though I would face questions and disappointment from my family, I had been given a gift—a testimony. And in the words of the Prophet Joseph Smith, “I knew it, and I knew that God knew it, and I could not deny it.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: It was covenants that had impacted me, not my covenants but the covenants of those who came before me. The power of God in those covenants reached out after me. As Elder Patrick Kearon has taught, “He employs every possible measure to bring [us] back.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: We can see this promise being fulfilled in our day. In the Book of Mormon, the Lord made a covenant with Enos that the remnant of the people living at that time would someday receive his words and the fulness of the gospel of Jesus Christ. Was there a time limit to that covenant? That covenant would take more than 2,000 years to be fulfilled. So, no, there is no limit to the power of God in our covenants.
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Covenants with God are filled with incalculable power. They do not bless just the maker of the covenant but are generational in their impact. We are all the intended beneficiaries of countless covenants! Like the great binding power of gravity that stretches across the universe, covenants with God stretch over all time and all space.
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference
